reference: No matching GNU/POSIX payload CLI exists. Fixed contract outputs follow the documented INDEX format, porcelain columns, inventory filters, info fields and relative installed-state layout in docs/opus-payload.md and docs/sol-payload.md; Bash supplies type/help metadata.
coverage: Bash reports payload as a builtin and its help includes the configured short label and documented install/remove forms.
A one-record, relative-path INDEX produces the documented porcelain columns and available status.
Deferred follow-up requirements cover mocked helper argv/status behavior, rollback transaction behavior and image-level helper integration; ordinary inventory edges execute.
Native inventory filters, installed/available info, empty/default fields, nonregular state directories and usage errors on private relative files.
Bounded malformed/binary/overlong record skipping, missing/directory/FIFO INDEX refusal and nonregular FIFO state status, all through the native inventory API.
exclusions: No host repo, installed package state, default image path, network peer, archive extraction, or real bl-pkg.sh helper is accessed.
There is no GNU/POSIX oracle for payload operations; operation-level deferrals are not reported as passes.

cases.purpose: Check the Bash type metadata contract for the statically included payload command.
Check Bash help metadata contains the configured short label and install/remove forms without depending on Bash version text.
cases.script:
doc=$(help payload)
case "$doc" in
  *"payload: payload"*"payload install NAME..."*"payload remove "*)
    printf '%s\n' 'payload help contract present'
    ;;
  *)
    exit 1
    ;;
esac

cases.purpose: Verify the documented porcelain field order with one deterministic package record in the private fixture directory.
cases.script:
printf '%s\n' 'blpkg-v1 name=sample version=1.2.3 arch=x86_64 type=toolchain provides=bin/sample' > INDEX
PAYLOAD_REPO=. PAYLOAD_ROOT=. payload list --porcelain

cases.purpose: Bounded INDEX records with missing names, embedded NUL, a control byte, an overlong field and an overlong line are skipped with diagnostics; valid records before and after them retain their exact rows. No installer/helper runs.
cases.script:
mkdir repo
export PAYLOAD_REPO=repo PAYLOAD_ROOT=.
printf '%s\n' '# ignored comment' 'blpkg-v1 version=0' 'blpkg-v1 name=good version=1 provides=bin/good' > repo/INDEX
printf 'blpkg-v1 name=nul version=1\000tail\n' >> repo/INDEX
printf 'blpkg-v1 name=control version=\001\n' >> repo/INDEX
printf -v wide_field '%0256d' 0
printf 'blpkg-v1 name=wide version=%s\n' "$wide_field" >> repo/INDEX
printf -v wide_line '%8192s' ''
printf 'blpkg-v1 name=long provides=%s\n' "$wide_line" >> repo/INDEX
printf '%s\n' 'blpkg-v1 name=last version=2' >> repo/INDEX
payload list --porcelain

cases.purpose: List all, installed and available records from a relative INDEX and one regular state file.
cases.script:
mkdir -p repo root/var/lib/bl-pkg/installed
printf '%s\n' 'blpkg-v1 name=alpha version=1 arch=x86_64 type=tool provides=bin/alpha' 'blpkg-v1 name=beta version=2 arch=any provides=bin/beta' > repo/INDEX
printf 'txn=fixture-1\n' > root/var/lib/bl-pkg/installed/alpha
export PAYLOAD_REPO=repo PAYLOAD_ROOT=root
payload list --porcelain
printf 'installed-only\n'
payload list --installed --porcelain
printf 'available-only\n'
payload list --available -p
cases.stdout:
installed	alpha	1	bin/alpha
available	beta	2	bin/beta
installed-only
installed	alpha	1	bin/alpha
available-only
available	beta	2	bin/beta

cases.purpose: Info preserves record fields, default type, available status and the installed transaction identifier.
cases.script:
mkdir -p repo root/var/lib/bl-pkg/installed
printf '%s\n' 'blpkg-v1 name=alpha version=1 arch=x86_64 type=tool provides=bin/alpha' 'blpkg-v1 name=beta version=2 arch=any provides=bin/beta' > repo/INDEX
printf 'txn=fixture-1\n' > root/var/lib/bl-pkg/installed/alpha
export PAYLOAD_REPO=repo PAYLOAD_ROOT=root
payload info alpha
payload info beta
cases.stdout:
name:      alpha
version:   1
arch:      x86_64
type:      tool
provides:  bin/alpha
status:    installed (txn fixture-1)
name:      beta
version:   2
arch:      any
type:      payload
provides:  bin/beta
status:    available (not installed)
